architectural_units.name: Client
architectural_units.description: The client is the user of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Backend
architectural_units.description: The server is the software that is responsible for processing user requests.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for displaying information to the user.

architectural_units.name: Business Layer
architectural_units.description: This layer is the core of the application and is responsible for processing all the information.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for storing all the data.

architectural_units.name: Api Gateway
architectural_units.description: This component is the only one that interacts directly with the presentation layer.

architectural_units.name: Core
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for performing the business logic of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Mòdul analític
architectural_units.description: This service has the main function of obtaining and processing playlog, connection, and platform action data.

architectural_units.name: Api Player
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for communicating with the players, receiving all the information corresponding to them.

architectural_units.name: Web Socket
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for carrying out the communication between the platform and the players.

architectural_units.name: NestJS
architectural_units.description: Framework used to develop the different services that interact with each other.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: AWS object storage service used to store JSON documents containing playlogs, connections, and audit trails.

architectural_units.name: DynamoDB
architectural_units.description: AWS non-relational database service used to store playlogs in real time.

architectural_units.name: Amazon Athena
architectural_units.description: Service that allows performing SQL queries on data stored in Amazon S3.

architectural_units.name: AWS Glue
architectural_units.description: Serverless data integration service used for metadata storage and table definitions.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Streams
architectural_units.description: Data processing and ingestion service used for streaming data.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
architectural_units.description: Service used for loading large amounts of data into data stores.
Presentation layer communicates with Api Gateway via HTTP.
Api Gateway communicates with Core and Mòdul analític via TCP.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The Waapiti platform is a web service that follows the client-server architecture.

patterns.name: Three Layers
patterns.description: The client-server model uses a 3-layer architecture, where the system is divided into 3 layers: presentation, business, and data.

patterns.name: API Gateway
patterns.description: This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform.
